C0379.title: Trojan Account Theft and Impersonation Scam: Three Suspects Criminally Detained by Nanshan Police in Shenzhen
C0379.summary: In 2021, Nanshan police in Shenzhen cracked a series of impersonation fraud cases. The suspects, Lin and his wife Liang, created Trojan horse links to steal chat app account credentials and then defrauded the victims' friends and relatives.
